mods.name: GT: Not Leisure
mods.note: Re-added 2026-11-18. Needs matching GTNLLib and Better Questing API. Its Vein Mining Pickaxe is disabled by scripts/gtnl_disable_vein_pickaxe.zs; recheck its recipes and the config clamp on a bump. Config edits in mods.md.

mods.name: GTNLLib
mods.note: 1.1.1 failed at launch on Angelica 2.2.43; check the font mixin on a bump.

mods.name: Better Questing API
mods.note: For GTNL's quest lines.

mods.name: Twist Space Technology
mods.note: Reset GregTech.lang and TwistSpaceTechnology.cfg on update. 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 crash world start on the Bottled Chaos thionyl chloride null; 0.8.0 is installed. Do not update until fixed; see mods.md.

mods.name: 123Technology
mods.note: Releases before 2.2.1 crash on 2.9.0 stable, and 2.2.1 skips recipes with Twist loaded; its overpowered recipes are off in config-tweaks.md.

mods.name: Omni Miner
mods.note: warpledge's own fork of EZMiner 6.6 (GTO Ultimine block limits, per-mode feature switches); see mods.md. Client only so far. Upstream is tracked by the parked EZMiner entry.

mods.name: EZMiner
mods.note: Upstream of Omni Miner, never installed again. On a new release, read its changes and port into ~/Projects/ezminer-balanced only what's needed (crash, 2.9 or pack fixes), then bump lastTried.

mods.name: EZStorage
mods.note: scripts/simplestorage_gregified.zs names its ids; recheck them on a bump.

mods.name: Realistic World Gen 2
mods.note: Replaces the pack's 2.0.6. Biome Size Multiplier 1.7 in rwg2.cfg; continental settings only apply to new worlds.

mods.name: Angelica
mods.note: Pack ships 2.2.43; 2.2.46 installed 2026-11-15. Update for a fix you need (Angelica#2092 is still open), then test ChromaPatch and shaders, Distant Horizons and Xaero's maps.

mods.name: Xaero's Minimap
mods.note: Replaces JourneyMap; Navigator draws the VisualProspecting layers on it.

mods.name: Xaero's World Map
mods.note: Open Angelica#2092: crash with a lava-retexturing pack (Modernity) and the Witching Gadgets Thaumic Stone Extruder on screen.

mods.name: Trash Slot
mods.note: Replaced by Omni Tweaks 0.3.0 on 2026-11-21; don't run both, each adds a trash slot.

mods.name: MIAOKATZE Core
mods.note: The three Miao mods bundle the core version they want in their release assets and need 0.2.20 or newer; keep it in step.

mods.name: GT-Miao-Blueprint
mods.note: Needs MIAOKATZE Core; see that entry.

mods.name: GT-Steam-Reborn
mods.note: Needs MIAOKATZE Core; see that entry.

mods.name: GT-Simple-Wireless-Network
mods.note: Needs MIAOKATZE Core; see that entry.

mods.name: World Tooltips
mods.note: Shader-compatible continuation of GenuineSounds' mod. The repo moved to GTNotLeisure and Modrinth stops at 1.2.3-87; 88 to 90 are rebuilds with no source changes. The 1.2.3-87 release reworks the config; delete the old one on update.

mods.name: NEI Guess
mods.note: Search suggestions for the NEI box: favorites, history, quest items and chat item links. Client only; see mods.md.

mods.name: Better Foliage
mods.note: Re-added 2026-11-24 with both configs restored from backups/removed-mods/2026-11-18/. 2.0.1's notes fix the FalseTweaks crash and grass clipping, nothing about performance, so the FPS cost may return.

mods.name: DEConfig Integration
mods.note: Kept 2026-11-17. Unifies gear config under Draconic Evolution's GUI. Latest 1.0.3.D424 targets a March 2026 GTNH nightly, so a mixin failure at launch is possible; see mods.md.

mods.name: InfoHUD
mods.note: Replaces InGameInfoXML, whose jar is disabled. HUD editor on J and light overlay on L; see mods.md.

mods.name: OmniOcular Unofficial
mods.note: Client uses the full jar; the server uses OmniOcularUnofficial-<version>-server.jar. 1.7.x overwrites the English scripts from the upstream repo unless gtnhConfigAutoUpdate=false in its .cfg (set on both sides; see mods.md).

mods.name: Smooth Third-Person Camera
mods.note: Removed by 2026-11-20 after issues in game. Hooks the same camera as Shoulder Surfing Reloaded; test both together on a retry.

mods.name: Cinematic Respawn
mods.note: Removed by 2026-11-20 after issues in game.

mods.name: GTNH Planner
mods.note: Betas, though GitHub marks them stable. Plans live in gtnhplanner/plans.dat; back it up before a bump.

mods.name: Dashboard
mods.note: GTNH's HUD editor, client only, not shipped by 2.9.0. Needs GTNHLib, which the pack carries. Settings in config/dashboard/editor.cfg; PNGs for the HUD go in config/dashboard/images/.

mods.name: Neo ECO AE Extension
mods.note: On trial. GitHub is the official 1.7.10 repo; Modrinth lags it. Back up the world first; see mods.md.

mods.name: Distant Horizons
mods.note: Client and server run the same jar; config is in mods.md.

mods.name: ChromaPatch
mods.note: A bump that moves the patch profile's base= commit pairs with moving the Eclipse pin. Then launch once so ChromaPatch rebuilds KuraEdit, and rebuild Warpledge Edit with eclipse-warpledge-edit/build.py (shaders.md). Check the new defaults against eclipse-warpledge-edit/settings.txt.

mods.name: Eclipse Shader
mods.note: Pinned to the commit ChromaPatch targets; newer commits may fail to patch, and a move means rebuilding the patched pack. See shaders.md.

mods.name: Kura packs and config
mods.note: KuraNeon, KuraReflections, KuraBetterCoils, KuraNeonExtras and KuramA's Eclipse config, taken from main. A new config overwrites your own settings.

mods.name: Euphoria Patcher
mods.note: Only the NeonTech fallback uses it, not the active Eclipse setup. Pinned to match NeonTech; a bump means copying the NeonTech values by hand.

mods.name: GTNH Modernization Upgrade
mods.note: Alpha, one author, AI-written. Renamed GTNH: Handy & Nimble; 0.4.x needs 2.9.1 and its ME Resonance Casing takes 23 replacements in an existing vault. The ME storage vault keeps inventory in <world>/data/aestoragevault/, and 0.3.0 changed that format without reading 0.2.x. Removing the mod strands its blocks and stored items; back up the whole world dir.

mods.name: AE2 Wireless Transceiver
mods.note: Each release ships a plain asset and a -gtnh2.8.4 one; the plain asset is the 2.9 build.

mods.name: Benzene Fuels
mods.note: Needs GoodGenerator and GT++ (miscutils).

mods.name: Patchee
mods.note: No public page, so the update check reports no-source. Its server-side parts are the ServerUtilities team chunk cap and the VeinMiner control.

mods.name: EZStorage Craft Fix
mods.note: Caches recipe lookups for Simple Storage; see mods.md. Client only so far.

mods.name: Smooth Swapping
mods.note: Animates item stacks between slots; config screen in the Mods list. Client only.

mods.name: Craft Chain
mods.note: Crafting overlay that plans and runs grid-recipe chains through NEI's auto-crafting; see mods.md. Client only.

mods.name: AE2Things
mods.note: Continues asdflj's repo, which stops at v1.2.14. 1.3.0 adds an Applied Botanics submodule that needs Botania; the pack has 1.13.42.

mods.name: DiskTerminal Unofficial
mods.note: Port of Aedial's DiskTerminal for cells and storage buses. config/disk_terminal_server.cfg must match both sides; see mods.md.

mods.name: LagGoggles
mods.note: Installed 2026-11-09. It was parked because it was built against FalsePatternLib 1.10.7 while the pack ships 1.12.2; loading is the proof.

mods.name: BoxPlusPlus
mods.note: Sits on GT multiblock internals that 2.9 rewrote.

mods.name: PICO-8 GTNH
mods.note: Client failed at GregTech post-init with it installed; see mods.md.

mods.name: Fission-Evolved
mods.note: Client failed at GregTech post-init with it installed; see mods.md.
